latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Mockup Generator.

- Instantly generate device mockup videos by uploading images or videos and describing the desired output.
- Automatic cloud connection and session creation; users get 100 free credits (expiry: 7 days) via anonymous token.
- Supports uploads up to 200MB (MP4, MOV, PNG, JPG recommended) with 1080p MP4 export by default.
- API-driven workflow: upload, credits, export, and status checks with detailed cloud render pipeline.
- Error handling with clear user feedback for all major cases (token, session, file format, quota).
- Designed for marketers and app developers to create professional mockup videos in seconds.
